svg.title: ADR026 wireframe: CLI
svg.text: Blue = new inferred suggestion · Prompts and messages in white are today's wording · Illustrative output

g.text: # 1 · Interactive local init — currency prefilled from the POSIX locale
$ echo $LANG
de_DE.UTF-8
$ bea init ~/books
Suggested EUR from LANG=de_DE.UTF-8. Press Enter to accept or type another code.
Operating currency [EUR]: ⏎
Earliest date you will record (opening balances must be as of this date) [2026-10-26]: ⏎
Checking opening balance on 2026-10-26 (negative for an overdraft) [0]: 1250
✓ Created ~/books/main.bean with 14 accounts in EUR.
Next: cd ~/books && bea check
# 2 · No usable locale (LANG=C or en without region) — today's USD default
$ LANG=C bea init ~/books-c
Operating currency [USD]: ▍
# 3 · Unattended — no inference, unchanged behavior
$ LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 bea --no-input init ~/books2
Error: Choose an operating currency with --currency USD (or EUR, etc.).
$ echo $?
# 4 · Hosted create — passes only what the caller supplies
$ bea cloud ledger create household --preset personal@1 --currency EUR
✓ Created alice/household (private) — personal@1, EUR
$ bea cloud ledger create scratch --preset personal@1
✓ Created alice/scratch (private) — personal@1, USD
(documented default; the account's saved EUR is not applied)
What changes, what does not
Interactive bea init (new)
Reads LC_ALL › LC_MONETARY › LANG. When the
region maps through the CLI's generated copy of
the region table, it becomes the prompt default,
and one line says where it came from.
The terminal is the only signal; no network call.
No region → USD, as today
C/POSIX locales and language-only values give
no hint; the prompt keeps its USD default.
Scripts never meet an inferred value
--no-input (or no TTY) still requires --currency
and exits 2 with nothing written — even when
LANG would map to a currency.
bea cloud ledger create: no inference
It is an API caller. An omitted --currency takes
the server's documented default (USD), never the
account's saved defaultCurrency or the local LANG.
Never touched by locale
• --preset: personal@1 stays the household default
• account names: ASCII English in the file
• amounts typed at prompts: "1250" or "1250.00";
the CLI keeps its locale-independent number parsing
Prompt wording in rows 1–3 is today's init.py text; the blue
hint line and row 4's result lines are illustrative.
